description: Verify that Client-Mode + clientServiceSubscribeEventgroup + Offer — DUT emits Subscribe
approach:
[Objective]
Client mode subscribe: clientServiceSubscribeEventgroup followed by an OfferService triggers DUT to emit a Subscribe.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_dut_subscribe: DUT did not emit Subscribe within listen window
